subject: Recap + Pilot proposal: 4-week evaluation sprint and success KPIs
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hart <claire.hart@oxbridge-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 14:18:00 +0100
Subject: Recap + Pilot proposal: 4-week evaluation sprint and success KPIs

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed pilot structure so we can lock timelines and owners. I included a short success-criteria workbook and a scoped plan as attachments.

High-level objective
- Validate retrieval-augmented workflows across two stores (store-level product catalogue + receipts ingestion) with latency & cost targets aligned to production SLAs.

Proposed 4-week evaluation sprint (summary)
Week 0 (kickoff) — data readiness, access, and environment prep
Week 1 — baseline integration (sample ingestion, retrieval config)
Week 2 — evaluation against 3 prompt families + automated quality checks
Week 3 — tuning, stress run, cost analysis, and wrap-up

Success criteria (what we measure)
1) Intent accuracy for the three core prompt families >= 88% on your labeled set
2) Average generation latency (p50/p95) <= 320ms / <= 850ms in eu-west region
3) Token cost per request at or below the ballpark we discussed (~$0.01–$0.03 per request with caching enabled)
4) End-to-end pipeline able to process your 10k sample batch within an 8-hour window during the stress run

Ownership (proposed)
- Redwood: integration lead (Marissa) for ingestion & infra, runtime tuning (Karthik) for batching and quantization guidance, and me as primary sponsor
- Oxbridge: data lead and product owner to sign off on KPI test sets and provide sample data access

Next steps / asks
1) Please confirm the three KPI items above and that EU-only processing is required (we can run in eu-west or ship a Private instance if you need on-premises)
2) Share a 10k-row sample dataset (anonymized) or confirm a short S3 link for secure transfer by Tue 25 May
3) Confirm kickoff: propose Tue 27 May at 10:00 BST for a 30-minute technical handoff

Attachments included:
- oxbridge_pilot_success_criteria.xlsx (success measurements & test definitions)
- oxbridge_pilot_scope.md (scope, timeline, roles)

If this looks good I’ll loop Marissa and Karthik on the technical kickoff invite and we’ll prepare the environment checklist.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +44 20 7946 0857

From: Claire Hart <claire.hart@oxbridge-retail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Price <oliver.price@oxbridge-retail.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Recap + Pilot proposal: 4-week evaluation sprint and success KPIs

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear plan. A few questions before we confirm: 

1) Data residency & compliance: can you confirm whether processing will be in the EU only? We have strict GDPR constraints and prefer EU hosting or an on-prem option.
2) Cost estimate: can you give a more concrete estimate for the 4-week run (approx. VM/GPU hours + tokens)? We need a rough number to take to procurement.
3) Sample data: we can provide an S3 export but need to know expected file format and credentials method.
4) Technical point of contact: who should our engineers loop in for the handoff?

We’re generally comfortable with the success criteria but want to ensure the latency and cost buckets are realistic. Proposed kickoff Tue 27 May at 10:00 BST looks good — can you confirm final attendee list?

Best,
Claire Hart
Director of Product | Oxbridge Retail
claire.hart@oxbridge-retail.com

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Recap + Pilot proposal: 4-week evaluation sprint and success KPIs

Claire —

Thanks for the quick questions — answers inline below and a short implementation checklist attached.

1) Data residency: we can run the pilot in our eu-west region (single-tenant processing) and can provide a Private VPC deployment if you require zero-exfiltration / dedicated networking. Both options support SOC2-level controls and KMS integration.

2) Cost estimate (rough) for 4-week sprint:
- Hosted in eu-west (shared): ~£4.5k–£7k total (includes tokenized usage + transient GPU bursts for stress runs)
- Dedicated pilot reservation (small pool): ~£9k (guaranteed throughput, lower per-token cost)
We’ll provide a line-item estimate in the next doc for procurement.

3) Sample data format: newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) or CSV is fine; S3 presigned URL preferred. We’ll provide a secure ingestion role if you want to avoid exposing credentials. Please share a small sample (1–2k rows) first, then the full 10k once we validate ingestion.

4) Technical POC: Marissa will lead the integration and Karthik will support runtime tuning. I’ll join the kickoff to align success criteria. Please include Oliver and your engineering lead on the invite.

Proposed attendees: Claire, Oliver, Oxbridge eng lead, Marissa Cole (Redwood integration), Karthik Iyer (Redwood runtime), Jonas Weber (owner)

I attached a one-page piloting checklist to help your eng team prepare (pilot-implementation-checklist.pdf).

If that all works I’ll draft the kickoff invite for Tue 27 May at 10:00 BST and attach the procurement-ready estimate.

Best,
Jonas

Attachments included:
- pilot-implementation-checklist.pdf (short runbook for ingestion & access)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Internal: Oxbridge pilot — prep tasks and owners

Folks —

Quick internal note after Claire’s reply. Kickoff confirmed for Tue 27 May 10:00 BST (pending calendar invite). Action items: 

Marissa
- Prepare ingestion role and short S3 presigned-url flow by EOD Mon 24 May (Claire asked for secure transfer).
- Review sample format in oxbridge_pilot_scope.md and confirm mapping for product catalog fields.

Karthik
- Draft recommended runtime config (batching/kv-cache, quantization profile) for eu-west to hit the latency/cost targets; include fallback model variant for low-memory runs.
- Prepare quick cost breakdown (hosted vs reserved) for procurement doc.

Me
- Send calendar invite to Claire/Oliver/oxbridge eng lead and attach procurement estimate and the success criteria workbook.

Notes: Claire prefers EU-only processing; be ready to sketch the Private VPC option if they push on compliance. I’ll own procurement touchpoints.

Thanks —
Jonas
